0022600161.text: The Brooklyn Nets (1-5, 15th in the East) visit the New York Knicks (2-4, 11th in the East) in the seventh game of the season for the Nets. Egor Demin (out, leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (out, shoulder sprain) are unavailable for Brooklyn. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Nets lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 93-92 loss in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026.
